text:
matt_j: FYI saw a spike of KMS access alerts from eu-west-1 over the last 20m. Lots of them look like CI runners rather than human creds. https://siem.internal/alerts/1856789012 :point_up:
devsec-bot: Alert created: kms-anomalous-region (severity: medium) — 76 hits in 20m. Related logs attached.
sara_g: Are these tied to a small set of principals or many different ones? can we pull the sessionName/principal from CloudTrail?
ashwin: quick check shows ~4 distinct assumed-role principals but many session_names are generic; pipeline metadata not present in logs.
ashwin: proposal: stop blanket suppression. instead enrich events with instance/service metadata + maintain a short-lived "pipeline_principals" whitelist lookup in SIEM. then rule does lookup and only fires if NOT in whitelist.
ashwin: suggested correlation key: concat(principalArn, resourceArn, requestParameters.cipherKeyId) — reduces duplicates from retries.
karla: Agree on enrichment. We should also update runners to set sessionName to "ci-pipeline/<pipeline-id>" on AssumeRole so CloudTrail has a clear identifier. small change in infra.
sara_g: that change would let us do simple pattern match rather than heuristic. timeline? ops team can push a change in the next deploy window.
ashwin: Example Splunk/SPL snippet to count unique principals and simulate whitelist impact:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt
| stats dc(userIdentity.arn) as unique_principals by awsRegion
| join type=left [| inputlookup pipeline_principals.csv | fields principal_arn]
| where isnull(principal_arn)
```
karla: Instead of inputlookup file we can use a small DynamoDB-backed lookup that the SIEM queries or a daily push job. TTL = 7d for ephemeral pipelines.
matt_j: Good. For immediate triage — can we add a temporary enrichment in the SIEM (join EC2 tags by instanceId) and suppress alerts that match tag role=pipeline for 2 hours while infra patch rolls out? Ops, ok to allow 2h window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops-lead: fine to allow 2h targeted suppression if it's scoped to those instance tags and we log the suppression decisions. create runbook entry and Slack webhook to notify #incidents when suppression flips on/off.
sara_g: Post-incident actions: 1) patch runners to set sessionName 2) add pipeline_principals lookup 3) add dashboard panel showing KMS anomalies with "in-whitelist" vs "out-of-whitelist" counts 4) 72h follow-up to verify FP drop.
karla: Also add a small alert that triggers if the whitelist grows > 50 principals in 24h (detect potential exfil attempt disguised as pipelines).
ashwin: I'll open a short PR for the SIEM rule change and a GH issue for the runner change. tagging @ops-lead for deploy schedule.
matt_j: Thanks folks. quick win: I'll request the 2h scoped suppression now and we monitor. :thumbsup: 
ops-lead: suppression enabled at 1856789100, will auto-disable at 1856789800. logging enabled.
devsec-bot: Automated note: suppression started by matt_j (ticket SIEM-3412).
karla: leaving a note to update the incident postmortem template with "enrichment-first" approach.
sara_g: will follow up with dashboard mockups in #eng-observability.
matt_j: closing loop — will post final numbers after 24h. thanks!
